cond_0001.intro:
The Finance Graduate Program (FGP) takes experienced, high-performing graduate students that have just completed their degree and places them into three, eight-month rotations in our most strategic and critical roles. In this accelerated leadership program, candidates are working directly with our senior leaders on providing insights, in-depth solutions and driving change across a variety of quantitative, strategic management and process engineering roles.
The landscape of the financial industry is changing rapidly and it's important for [Company name masked] to adapt to the needs of our clients and invest in our future. The FGP gives you the opportunity to evolve Corporate Finance into a true business partner. The FGP is looking to hire Builders, Persuaders and Strategists to:
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Manage the design, development and implementation of multiple, highly-complex, improvement projects that promote organizational efficiency, reduce costs and drive revenue
Develop and implement multifaceted models to transform data into business insights and strategies
Lead transformation by influencing a culture of adaptability, excellence and collaboration
Finance Graduate Program Highlights
Two-years: three, eight-month rotation assignments
Direct access to senior leaders
High exposure to strategic and critical projects
Leadership and management training/experience
Continuous culture of feedback through in-depth candidate and manager assessments
Community outreach volunteer events
Leadership Expert Series
Enter as Assistant Vice President
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Currently enrolled in a full-time graduate program and graduating in the 2024 academic year
Master's in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, Math, Economics, Statistics, Engineering, Information Systems, Data Science, Computer Science or equivalent
3 - 6 Years' professional experience
Demonstrated problem solving and influencing skill-set
Analytical, managerial and organizational skills
Advanced in Excel and data management
Deep knowledge of the financial markets and industry
Preferred Requirements
Highly successful working independently, in teams and across a matrixed environment
Change management and innovative mind-set
Intermediate in coding (R, Python, SQL, etc.)

In this accelerated leadership program, candidates work directly with our senior leaders to provide insights, in-depth solutions and support change across a variety of quantitative, strategic management and process engineering roles.
The landscape of the financial industry is changing rapidly and it's important for [Company name masked] to adapt to the needs of our clients and invest in our future. The FGP gives you the opportunity to help evolve Corporate Finance into a true business partner. The FGP is looking to hire Builders, Persuaders and Strategists.
cond_0252.responsibilities:
Coordinate the design, development and implementation of multiple, highly-complex improvement projects that promote organizational efficiency, reduce costs and support revenue growth
Work with stakeholders to develop and implement multifaceted models that transform data into shared business insights and strategies
Support transformation by helping build a culture of adaptability, excellence and collaboration
Finance Graduate Program Highlights
Three, eight-month rotation assignments
Direct access to senior leaders
High exposure to strategic and critical projects
Leadership and management training/experience
Continuous culture of feedback through in-depth candidate and manager assessments
Community outreach volunteer events
Leadership Expert Series
Enter as Assistant Vice President
cond_0252.requirements:

cond_0301.intro:
The Finance Graduate Program (FGP) takes experienced, high-performing graduate students that have just completed their degree and places them into three, eight-month rotations in our most strategic and critical roles. In this accelerated leadership program, candidates are working directly with our senior leaders on providing insights, in-depth solutions and driving change across a variety of quantitative, strategic management and process engineering roles.
The landscape of the financial industry is changing rapidly and it's important for [Company name masked] to adapt to the needs of our clients and invest in our future. The FGP gives you the opportunity to evolve Corporate Finance into a true business partner. The FGP is looking to hire Builders, Persuaders and Strategists. People who do well in this program are often quick to grasp the logic of financial systems and the analytical work involved.
cond_0301.responsibilities:
Manage the design, development and implementation of multiple, highly-complex, improvement projects that promote organizational efficiency, reduce costs and drive revenue
Develop and implement multifaceted models to transform data into business insights and strategies
Lead transformation by influencing a culture of adaptability, excellence and collaboration
Finance Graduate Program Highlights
Two-years: three, eight-month rotation assignments
Direct access to senior leaders
High exposure to strategic and critical projects
Leadership and management training/experience
Continuous culture of feedback through in-depth candidate and manager assessments
Community outreach volunteer events
Leadership Expert Series
Enter as Assistant Vice President

Change management and innovative mind-set

In this accelerated leadership program, candidates are working directly with our senior leaders on providing insights, in-depth solutions and driving change across a variety of quantitative, strategic management and process engineering roles.
We're looking for you
The landscape of the financial industry is changing rapidly and it's important for [Company name masked] to adapt to the needs of our clients and invest in our future. The FGP gives you the opportunity to evolve Corporate Finance into a true business partner. The FGP is looking to hire Builders, Persuaders and Strategists to:
Manage the design, development and implementation of multiple, highly-complex, improvement projects that promote organizational efficiency, reduce costs and drive revenue
Develop and implement multifaceted models to transform data into business insights and strategies
Lead transformation by influencing a culture of adaptability, excellence and collaboration
Finance Graduate Program Highlights
Two-years: three, eight-month rotation assignments
Direct access to senior leaders
High exposure to strategic and critical projects
Leadership and management training/experience
Continuous culture of feedback through in-depth candidate and manager assessments
Community outreach volunteer events
Leadership Expert Series
Enter as Assistant Vice President
